text:
zoe: Hi all  first week here. Trying to compile runtime on my workstation (Ubuntu 22.04, RTX 3090) using `./scripts/build.sh --cuda`. Hitting ptxas complaint about compute_75. Anyone got a quick pointer? @paige

paige: welcome! :wave: Can you paste `nvcc --version` and the ptxas snippet? 3090 is Ampere (8.6/8.7 depending), so compute_75 is unexpected.

zoe: nvcc:
``nVCC: NVIDIA (R) Cuda compiler driver
Cuda compilation tools, release 11.4, V11.4.100
``
ptxas:
``[ 14%] Building CUDA object src/runtime/CMakeFiles/runtime_cuda.dir/conv_kernels.cu.o
ptxas fatal   : ValueError: Unsupported gpu architecture 'compute_75'
CMake Error at cmake/FindCUDA.cmake:1320 (message):
  ptxas died with status 1
```

ben: hmm looks like cmake autodetected 75 (Turing) even though you have 3090. Could be stale CMake cache or an env var in your shell. Run a fresh build dir and ensure `CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES` is set.

paige: try:
``export CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=86
rm -rf build && cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build build -j
```
That forces sm_86 generation. If your nvcc is 11.4 you might still hit ptxas oddities; recommended dev image is `redwood/dev:cuda-12` in our docs.

zoe: I did a fresh build dir and set the env var, got past ptxas but then hit undefined reference to `cublasCreate_v2` at link time. I had mixed system libs from a different toolkit. Pulled docker image `redwood/dev:cuda-12`, rebuilt inside container and everything linked.

ci-bot: Note: CI uses matrix rows for cuda-11.8 (ampere) and cuda-12 (4090/12.x). Please make sure any changes to cmake/Arch.cmake preserve both integer and sm_* mappings.

zoe: Build succeeded :tada: Will open a tiny doc PR adding a short note to docs/dev-setup.md: "If nvcc reports unsupported compute_X, either set CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES to your GPU's arch integer (e.g., 86) or use redwood/dev:cuda-12 to match CI."

devex-bot: Suggestion: include the exact `nvcc --version` and `nvidia-smi` outputs and the failing ptxas snippet in the PR so others can grep similar failures.

paige: please tag `chore(dev): clarify cuda arch detection` and ping dev-experience. welcome aboard and glad it worked!
